dct_description_sm: Altitudinal transects were established for the purpose of measuring the pattern and composition of the treeline ecotone on opposing slope aspects. Treeline is expected to advance with climate warming and a record of conditions during the IPY period can be used as a benchmark against which change can be measured. In addition, the data provides an indication of the fashion by which tree size and density, as well as species composition, changes across the ecotone and how it varies with aspect.
dct_title_s: Treeline Vegetation Transects in Southwest Yukon
